portInfo.description: Stornoway Harbour on the Isle of Lewis is the main seaport of the Outer Hebrides and an established cruise call. The Port Authority’s cruise page states the new Deep Water Terminal handles vessels up to 360 m, while ships under 156 m use Inner Harbour piers 1 and 3 in the town centre. Cruise Ambassadors meet passengers and distribute town/island maps (Lews Castle, Callanish, Carloway Broch, blackhouses). A Cruise Scotland industry member page adds berth depths, a tender pontoon note and “town centre 5 km / shuttle yes” framing for the deep-water facility — treat those figures as secondary unless matched on SPA pages.
